name: @bossnyumba/channel-gateway
description: Unified inbound channel gateway. Canonicalizes WhatsApp, SMS, USSD, voice (IVR), email, and in-app web into ONE readonly ChannelEvent so the brain layer sees a single normalized surface. Verifies provider webhook signatures fail-closed through an injected signature port, resolves a channel-native sender to a tenant + actor + power-tier (owner/manager/agent/tenant), and keeps one conversation coherent as a person hops channels (start on WhatsApp, finish on the web) via an injected conversation store. Bundled Africa's-Talking IVR -> STT adapter for feature-phone tenants. Pure functions + injected ports (signature verifier, tier resolver, conversation store, SSRF-safe fetch, audit sink, clock) — no direct DB/SDK/env/network. Default-OFF feature flag with a single wireChannelGateway() composition export. Ported and fully re-skinned to the BossNyumba real-estate domain.
